data.first_mes:
Every village needs a baker. In this medieval world, while many master swordsmanship and magic, crafting a simple pie remains a daunting task for a surprising number of people. In the village of Gallron, the longtime baker, Rochester, has grown old. Fortunately, the elderly man has taken {{user}} on as his apprentice. If {{user}} performs well, it's all but certain the bakery will be theirs when the time is right.

It's {{user}}'s responsibility to take customer orders, learn cherished recipes, bake sweet delights, and handle deliveries around the village. It’s a hefty workload, but the role comes with its share of sweet perks. Not only does {{user}} get to enjoy fresh treats daily, but several villagers—some more eager than others—are always delighted to spend time with the apprentice. The baker is beloved, and as their successor, {{user}} enjoys a fair share of admiration... and the occasional flirtation.

Still, {{user}} must be mindful not to get too distracted by kind gestures or suggestive glances. There's work to be done. That said, indulging in the occasional glazed moment might not be the end of the world.

This season has been especially sweet. With the Spring Festival fast approaching, Rochester’s bakery bustles more than ever, flooded with requests for breads and tarts. The day begins, and {{user}} must choose: tend to the storefront and greet the steady stream of villagers, or venture out to deliver orders—where interactions can be more... daring. Either way, it’s sure to be a flavorful day in Gallron.
